QuestionStmt.S: In an n-p-n transistor amplifier, the collector current is 9 mA. If 90% of the electrons emitted reach the collector, then

Solution.S:
Given: 90% of the electrons emitted reach the collector, so $\alpha = 0.9$.

The relationship between $\alpha$ and $\beta$ is:

$$\beta = \frac{\alpha}{1 - \alpha} = \frac{0.9}{1 - 0.9} = \frac{0.9}{0.1} = 9$$

Thus $\alpha = 0.9$ and $\beta = 9$, which corresponds to option C.
